# Belinda

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Role:** Domestic servant  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Titles:** Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

Belinda has a small frame and brown paws, and she is noted for having a exceptionally broad smile. Her hair is worn in braids that she sometimes fixes into wild crinkles or two pigtails. She often wears white dresses and bright blue ribbon bows on her hair, which sometimes stick out like oversized wings from her neck.

_Sources: [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c27 P45](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0045), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 c30 P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013), [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027)_

## Personality

Belinda is a matter-of-fact, diligent, and deeply devoted handmaiden who worries constantly about potential disasters. She possesses little patience for men, admitting she fears she was meant to be a spinster. Despite her anxious tendency to prepare for the worst, she carries a cheerful, energetic manner while attending to her duties. She holds Nell in total admiration, frequently attempting to imitate her speech, posture, and grace.

_Sources: [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c28 P53](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0053), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 c30 P16](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0016), [v2 c30 P28](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0028)_

## History

Leonora Bowman entered the service of Miss Rosalind Harcourt at Echo Cottage following her three older sisters. Because Miss Rosalind repeatedly called her servants 'Belinda' after the original maid, Leonora became known as Belinda the Fourth. She regularly assisted Miss Rosalind in preparing meals and hostings, including an impromptu tea party for Nell and Isolde Pembroke, where she demonstrated the cottage's famous echoes using a tin horn and laughter. Throughout Nell's visits, Belinda developed immense admiration for her and practiced mimicking her poise in front of a mirror. When Miss Rosalind grew weary and sick, Belinda anxiously confided her concerns to Nell. During Stephen Stanhope's visit, Belinda expressed her hopes that he would marry Miss Rosalind so her mistress would be taken care of when Belinda eventually left for Boston. In the weeks leading up to the wedding, she worked energetically to ready the stone house, fussed over the food, and panicked about the weather and potential disasters. On the wedding day, she wore white with vibrant blue ribbon bows, held hands with Nell and Isolde during the ceremony, and broke into tears after the couple departed, feeling that the empty house resembled the aftermath of a funeral.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 c21 P68](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0068), [v2 c21 P70](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0070), [v2 c21 P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 c21 P72](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0072), [v2 c21 P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055), [v2 c29 P0](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0000), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 c30 P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014), [v2 c30 P22](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0022), [v2 c30 P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027), [v2 c30 P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 c30 P35](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0035)_

## Background by volume

- Her actual name is Leonora Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She is the youngest of the Bowman daughters  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Her elder sisters Belinda, Julietta (Belinda II), and Evelina (Belinda III) previously served Miss Rosalind  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She came to live with Miss Rosalind in exchange for room, board, and garments  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

> Please, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, it can easily be noticed that a secret exists between you and Miss Rosalind, and I believe, asking for your forgiveness if I am being overly bold, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, that withholding it from me is truly unkind, considering how close we have all been as friends.  <sub>[v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>

> It’s my hope he weds Miss Rosalind. Certain women are meant to be spinsters right from the beginning, and I fear I belong to that group, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, on account of having precious little tolerance for men.  <sub>[v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>
